project.title: Effects of oil and gas wastewater components on microbial community structure and function
project.description: Sediments recovered upstream and downstream of an oil and gas wastewater disposal facility were incubated in the presence of several components of oil and gas wastewater, including synthetic brine, ethylene glycol, and DBNPA
